        Two fixes, depending on what the test is for:
        
          Query correctness — use the real harness (real SQLite, real migrations):
            jest.mock('@/db/client', () =>
              require('../../../jest/drizzleTestHarness').createClientMock());
            then createTestDb() / setTestDrizzleDb(db) in beforeEach.
            See jest/drizzleTestHarness/README.md.
        
          Caller behaviour only — keep the suite's own mock and fill the gaps:
            jest.mock('@/db/client', () => ({
              ...require('../../../jest/drizzleTestHarness').clientMockDefaults(),
              /* the suite's existing overrides */
            }));
          ...or mock the ported repository module itself, matching how this suite
          already mocks that repository's siblings.
